description.zh: 数据集版本描述,长度不超过1024
description.en: The description for this dataset version. Maximum length: 1,024 characters.

description.zh: 数据集ID，当前仅支持DataWorks数据集
description.en: The dataset ID. Currently supports DataWorks datasets only.

description.zh:
数据集的存储导入配置, 对于不同存储类型，需要的配置信息不同
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
取值可参考文件存储 API DescribeFileSystems 的返回信息

```JSON
{
  "fileSystemId": "3b6XXX89c9", // 文件系统ID
  "fileSystemStorageType": "Performance", // 文件系统的存储规格
  "vpcId": "vpc-uf66oxxxrqge1t2gson7s" // 挂载点的VPC ID
}
```

</details>
description.en:
The storage import configuration for the dataset. Required configuration varies by storage type.

**NAS**

For valid values, see the response from the file storage API DescribeFileSystems.

```JSON
{
"fileSystemId": "3b6XXX89c9", // The file system ID.
"fileSystemStorageType":  "Performance" // The file system storage type.
"vpcId": "vpc-uf66oxxxrqge1t2gson7s" // The VPC ID for the mount point.
}
```

description.zh: 挂载路径，需要以/mnt/开头，默认为/mnt/data
description.en: The mount path, which must start with /mnt/. Default value: /mnt/data.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public create-dataset-version --dataset-id dataworks-dataset:3pXXXb8o0ngr07njhps1 --comment this_is_a_comment --url oss://test-oss-bucket/test_dir/ --mount-path /mnt/data --import-info key=example-string --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
